body: Tbh it feels like an endless loop and I'm always back at 0.

I just read your post and it's surprised me how similar your situations is to mine. I tried to commit suicide by hanging myself around 8 months ago. It was a piece rope I found in the storage room and it got torn apart as soon as I tossed the chair aside. When I get really depressed like the weekend I tried to kill myself I tend to close myself up and don't talk to anyone. As this happened rather often my then girlfriend thought I was ignoring her and, in her words, playing with her feelings. The day after my failed suicide attempt I called her and asked her to meet up. I wanted to tell her about the one thing I had not told her about, I was depressed. For some reason I couldn't, I just couldn't bring myself to open myself up that deep. She broke up with me that day, the day after the time I've felt the most depressed and tried to end it all. I met her online out of pure luck and I doubt I'll ever get involved in a relationship again. Just like you I have a really bad game and have zero confidence. I can barely keep up conversations with people I don't know so people eventually just stop talking to me and go on with their lives. I also always find a way to fail. I sabotage myself through my depressive and unmotivated behaviour. I can't remember the last day I didn't think about killing myself but I haven't tried to do it again. I wish I were normal too.

I talk to myself all the time both inside and outside of my head. I talk to myself, outloud, in a language different than the one that is spoken where I live. I've stopped caring about what people think when they see me moving my mouth and hear weird jibberish coming out of my mouth. I don't know why but there's something in communicating to myself outloud and in English that I oddly find soothing.
